basic_details.job_title: IIIT Sri City Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City (IIIT Sri City) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Associate post on a project-based engagement for a tenure of 1 year. Candidates holding a B.Tech./B.E. in CSE/ECE/DSAI/Equivalent disciplines can apply online from 12 October 2026 to 25 October 2026. The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,000 p.m., and the selection process consists of shortlisting based on project needs followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates under advertisement number IITI/AgriHub/P-III/2026/PRJ-I/01.

how_to_apply: Access the online application form using the official application link.
Upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae describing the working knowledge as per the notification.
Upload soft copies of Mark Sheets and Certificates.
Submit the application online on or before 25 October 2026. No email submissions are entertained.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Sri City Project Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City, Chittoor
AgriHub: Innovation Hub for Agriculture (AI/ML & Deep Learning CoE), IIT Indore, Govt. of India
AgriDrone-Phenotype: A UAV-Based Imaging and Deep-Learning Framework for Growth Rate Estimation and Plant Counting in Field Phenotyping

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Academic Qualifications: B.Tech./B.E. in CSE/ECE/DSAI/Equivalent disciplines, with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above, with a 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PwD applicants. Desirable Academic Qualifications: Master Degree in related areas/specializations of CSE/ECE/DSAI/Equivalent disciplines, and/or working experience in areas related to image processing/computer vision, deep/machine learning, etc. Essential Skills Required: Knowledge in computer vision, image processing, or machine learning. Desirable Skills: Deep learning, and programming in Python & Pytorch.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Project Associate will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 25,000 p.m. The project duration is 1 year. The association between the Principal Investigator and the candidate can be discontinued at any time by giving one month’s notice in writing by either side. Selected candidates must be able to report to the institute immediately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Sri City Project Associate
content_sections.text: Access the online application form using the official application link. Upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae describing the working knowledge as per the notification. Upload soft copies of Mark Sheets and Certificates. Submit the application online on or before 25 October 2026. No email submissions are entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not ensure that a candidate will be called for an interview. Shortlisting is done based on the needs of the project. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Project Associate post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary for a project duration of 1 year, and association with the institute will automatically end on the closing date of the project.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in academic marks for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A 5% relaxation in marks is applicable for SC, ST, and PwD applicants meeting the essential academic qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is conducted based on the needs of the project, and possessing the prescribed qualifications does not guarantee a call for an interview.

faq.question: Q4. Where will interview details and shortlists appear?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the interview date, so applicants must provide valid email IDs in their applications.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be uploaded with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae describing working knowledge as per the notification, along with soft copies of mark sheets and certificates.
